Controller.Adb.Description: Set the emulator to a fixed 1280x720 resolution in landscape mode.
Preset.AutoLive.desc: Loop lives and perform them automatically.
Preset.UseFire.desc: Continuously monitor Live Boost and run lives to consume it when its amount is strictly greater than the entered threshold.
Task.StartUp.Description: Requires a 1280x720 landscape emulator. Find and click the game icon, then click the screen center once when the home menu appears.
Option.StartUpWait.Description: Increase this delay if the game is still loading when the tap occurs.
Task.UseFire.Description: Monitor the main view and consume Live Boost when its amount is greater than or equal to the entered threshold.
Option.LoopLiveCount.Description: Stop after the specified number of lives.
Option.LoopLive.UseLiveBoost.Description: Enter a non-negative integer. Consume Live Boost only when its amount is greater than or equal to this value.
Option.LoopLive.UseAFK.Description: Consume Live Boost by idling through lives without pressing any keys.
